currency.change: Normalize total remaining copper into gold, silver and copper; denomination labels do not restrict payment

generalStore.fallback: Use distinct eligible items from other permitted rarity tiers; never invent stock or include restricted equipment. Report categories with fewer than three eligible items.
generalStore.restartBehavior: Deterministic day index and world seed; persist purchased quantities

flashDeals.discountDistribution: Uniform integer percent from 15 through 40, stable for the daily rotation; charge ceil(baseCopper*(100-percent)/100), expose effective discount and omit offers outside 15–40% after rounding
